title: Sources & further reading
body:
Official and operator sources used for this pass: Matsue Castle, Izumo Taisha, Oda City tourism / Iwami Ginzan, Iwami Ginzan World Heritage Center, Ichibata Electric Railway, JR West, Izumo Airport, and the Japan Meteorological Agency for climate normals.

Entry/visa requirements and the current US travel advisory could not be confirmed against their official pages this pass (both blocked non-browser fetches) — re-check mofa.go.jp and travel.state.gov directly before booking.
